p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: the official resources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the up-to-date official sources, then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Card (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health regulations that this country imposes on products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trading with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: Taric: Customs Code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that a platform is not marked by a regulator before you entrust money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: A site opens in its own language: use the translation of your browser, or « Understand a document » for a document Before an important decision, ask a professional in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Tasks, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not file a customs declaration: an authorised customs broker (freight forwarder) can do this for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Card (ITC, UN-WTO): obligations and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: Taric: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transportation document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to get reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (companies importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, authorisation, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the goods to the buyer’s carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; after that, the buyer bears the risks and costs.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: the seller pays freight and insurance until the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: the seller delivers at destination, the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Everywhere prohibited or controlled: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are refused and can be reported (and).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the cost for your country before shipping.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn any money from these links: you compare here, then you send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Remittance Prices Worldwide (World Bank): the actual cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash pick-up in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash pick-up, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, charges will be shown before you send
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash pick-up
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total amount received: costs + exchange rate, a rate that is worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: Proof of identity is often required, both to send and to collect.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you met online only, or to "unlock" a prize, package, loan, or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stock: find a supplier, work out the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping is selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer, easy to start, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is authorized in your customers’ country: no counterfeit, no regulated product without authorization.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (Wholesale/supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the actual price: product, shipping costs, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment costs and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: company status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade Rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect the rights of customers: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment via unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
